instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard icons.
Implement the 'Control Room Grid' (gap-4, dense usage) for the Match Chart tracking view.
The Pricing page must feature a 2-column layout (Monthly vs Annual). Highlight the Annual plan strongly with a 'Save €25+/year' and 'Best Value' badge.
Use Recharts for the live match charts, ensuring lines use high-contrast neon accents (e.g., #007AFF) over the dark background.
Provide a clear Trial Banner displaying the 7-day FREE TRIAL countdown, utilizing the #007AFF or #FF3B30 colors for urgency.
Teams tab should organize data hierarchically: Leagues -> Teams -> Player Rosters. Use Shadcn Tabs or Tabs with internal scrolling.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, chart toggles) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., 'upgrade-annual-btn', 'add-match-chart').
Enforce dark mode permanently. Background is #0A0A0A and surfaces #141414. Do NOT use transparent headers; use Glassmorphism.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the marketing layout, avoiding rigid Shadcn layouts, but use Shadcn for components like Forms, Inputs, Tabs, Dialogs.
